<tspan x="1208.0" dy="0">Linear / outputs</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="722.5" y="725" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#cdeaf8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="745.5" y="738" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="745.5" dy="0">Tensor operations</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="805.0" y="766" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="805.0" dy="0">K=3 children; child_h/child_c:[3,16]; shared node gates and c,h:[1,16].</tspan>
<tspan x="805.0" dy="16.52">Summation uses dim0,keepdim=True; all child rows reuse the same learned four Linear families.</tspan>
<tspan x="805.0" dy="16.52">The selected actual method returns(c,h); recursive traversal is outside the diagram boundary.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="805.0" y="840" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="805.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="805.0" y="870" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="805.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="805.0" y="895" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="805.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
